title: Nameplate Collection
summary: 39 in-room nameplate assets. 13 agents x 3 styles (gold, silver, modern). Wall-mounted office nameplates that replace floating text labels with real office decor.
content:
Nameplate Collection

Steffen | 2026-03-16 39 assets. Real office decor, not UI chrome.

What This Is

Patrik directive: "Generate nameplate assets for the catalog. Clean office nameplates that sit ON the wall inside each room. Gold, silver, or modern minimal styles. Each agent's name. These replace the floating text labels. Should feel like real office decor, not UI chrome."

Done. 13 agents x 3 styles = 39 nameplate PNGs with JSON sidecars.

Styles

Gold (Brushed Metal)

  • Gradient: Gold to warm brass with reflective highlight
  • Mounting screws (left + right, 6px diameter)
  • 3D bottom edge shadow (voxel depth)
  • Agent signature color accent bar along bottom
  • Dark engraved text, 14px bold with 2.5px letter-spacing
  • Title/role underneath in smaller text
  • Classic boardroom energy

Silver (Brushed Steel)

  • Gradient: Cool steel to bright silver
  • Same mounting screws and 3D edge
  • Agent signature color accent bar
  • Dark text on bright metal
  • Professional, modern corporate feel

Modern (Dark + Color)

  • Dark navy background (#1A1A2E)
  • Agent signature color top accent bar (3px)
  • Agent name in their signature color with subtle glow
  • No mounting screws (clean minimal)
  • Rounded corners (6px vs 2px on metal styles)
  • Matches the blue HUD direction

Design Details

Size

  • Canvas: 128x64px (2x retina rendered)
  • Plate: 120x52px (centered with breathing room)
  • Text: 14px bold name, 7px title
  • Grid footprint: 2x1 sub-cells (wall placement)

Animation Specs

  • onPlace: bounceIn (spring from right side, wall mount feel)
  • onHover: shimmer (metallic shimmer effect on gold/silver, glow pulse on modern)
  • idle: subtleGlow (modern style only, soft pulsing glow in agent color)

Placement Rules

  • Wall placement only (top wall of each room)
  • Each agent's nameplate defaults to their own room
  • All three styles can coexist in the catalog
  • Default style assignment: Gold for Patrik, Modern for others
  • User can swap via the furniture picker

For Bobby: Integration

  1. Nameplates go ON THE WALL inside each room (not floating above)
  2. Position: centered on the back wall, about 60% up from the room floor
  3. Replace any existing floating text labels with these physical nameplate assets
  4. Each room gets ONE nameplate (the room owner's)
  5. Style selection: default Modern (matches blue HUD), Gold/Silver as catalog options
  6. The nameplate should bounce in AFTER the room loads (150ms delay, same as current nameplate delay)
  7. On hover, shimmer effect reveals the 3D metallic quality

Renders via Playwright. 128x64 transparent PNGs at 2x device pixel ratio.
